title: Stop writing Athena- trailers in commits after cutover C0
summary: Retry of job 20261025-001234-2hax: after cutover C0, commits from Committer::build_commit_in and commit_with_staged carry no Athena- trailers, and the trailer readers keep a C0..head fallback. A job PR holding job, intervention and records-only commits is landed with a merge commit and attributed by records. squash_text gets strict and relaxed forms.

defaults_applied.how: Behavior criteria checked by cargo test, including the scratch-repo test.
Fix at the two commit-writing chokepoints, not per call site.
Retry request recovered from the repository and the prior failure.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: stop Athena- trailers in commits after cutover C0 while keeping history/attribution checks and pre-C0 trailer readers working. Audience: maintainer and verifier running cargo test.
The retry's proposed request takes precedence: files in scope are widened to athena-gate lib.rs, core manage.rs, commits.rs, athena-git lib.rs, gh.rs and tests.
No standalone intervention or records-only PR is landed via land_pr, since it lands only a job PR.
No CLI-level conditional test; lifecycle.rs is left out.
I did not read the repository; paths come from the earlier critique.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test: a scratch-repository test builds one job PR whose range holds a job commit, a standalone intervention commit (via commit_with_staged) and a records-only commit (via Committer), after C0. It lands the PR through land_pr with the fake host's merge method stated in the test (merge commit, so all three reach HEAD). It asserts none of the commits has an 'Athena-' trailer line and that records attribute all three (kinds JobLanding, DeclaredIntervention, RecordsOnly). The test fails without the change.
Run cargo test: check_history and check_attribution pass on that post-C0 range (library-level call; a CLI-level athena check run only if included with a clear assertion in lifecycle.rs).

Run cargo test: commits made after C0 by Committer::build_commit_in and by commit_with_staged contain no Athena- trailer; commits before C0, and commits with no cutover_job or before its landing record exists, are unchanged with trailers, and all existing tests pass unchanged.

Run cargo test: a test shows that after C0 the history check skips content, invariant and jobs checks (runs only secrets and attribution), and that the gate's own check keeps content and jobs checks but drops trailer-dependent invariant::check.
Run cargo test: squash_text has a strict form and a relaxed (post-C0) form, each with a test; the relaxed squash commit carries no Athena- line.
Run cargo test: status and audit still read trailers on commits up to and including C0, with a C0..head fallback, giving the same results as before.
CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md describe the end of trailer writing after C0 (D111, job 7 part 1b), name which readers still use trailers up to C0, and describe the history check accurately.
cargo clippy, cargo fmt --check and cargo test are clean; no governance files (athena.toml, ci.yml) change.

out_of_scope: Landing standalone intervention or records-only PRs through land_pr
A conditional CLI-level test in lifecycle.rs
Removing trailer readers for commits up to C0
Changes to athena.toml or CI workflows
departures: Cross-crate change with a history of three failed planning rounds; slightly lower pass odds and higher cost than reference.
